summary.value: Unwilling to back down despite ruthless competitors, Gasgano leaves nothing behind on the track. With his four arms, he makes podracing look easy, earning the Xexto celebrity status.

description.value: Built from scratch to suit Gasgano's needs, his custom Ord Pedrovia podracer features a bespoke Afterburner tank, easily leaving competitors in the dust. Though this strength comes at the cost of increased drag, it's no matter to Gasgano, who's already pulled into the lead.
Afterburner power and tank refill rate are increased.
Vehicle drag is increased, reducing top speed.
